item.title: QuadRF can spot drones and see WiFi through my wall
item.description:
📝 QuadRF can spot drones and see WiFi through my wallJul 10, 2026The QuadRF (pictured above) a phased-array radio built around a Raspberry Pi 5 and an FPGA board with picosecond-level timing. It's just better to know what's possible and expose bad security practices than to ban useful tools like these. From the QuadRF Documentation:The novel approach of streaming I/Q over the Pi’s camera and display FFC MIPI connectors has many benefits.
🔗 Read more: https://www.jeffgeerling.com/blog/2026/quadrf-can-spot-drones-and-see-wifi-through-my-wall/

item.title: A Love Letter to Flashcards
item.description:
📝 Using spaced repetition as a general-purpose learning tool (rather than just for rote memorization of vocabulary) was perhaps the most important thing I learned from that course. From this perspective, fields that require deep understanding, like math, require memory just as fields with a breadth of shallow knowledge do, though in different ways. The difference is that rotation preserves orientation while reflection flips it.
🔗 Read more: https://lesleylai.info/en/flashcards/
